title: The Makropulos Case
facts: The opera received its world premiere at the National Theatre in Brno on 18 December 1926, conducted by František Neumann.
The Makropulos Affair (also The Makropoulos Case, The Makropulos Secret, or in Czech: Věc Makropulos, lit. 'The Makropulos Thing') is a Czech opera in 3 acts, with music and libretto by Leoš Janáček.
